name: OMTech FC-510 Intelli

editorialDepth.advantages: OMTech FC-510 Intelli 510W fits shops that mark stainless, aluminum, and tools daily without a CO₂ bay. A solid bench option for jewelry, tags, and small batches.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if wood, leather, or cast acrylic pay your bills. Deep metal cutting and large industrial panels often need more fiber headroom or a different machine class.
